scientific_integrity: All-order mathematical proof uses monomial beta moments, Euler-Pfaff hypergeometric transformations, Jacobi orthogonality and real-rooted Descartes equality. Exact-rational finite checks are corroboration only; no independent audit or novelty guarantee is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns the unnormalized Euclidean-distance power weight on complex balls of dimension at least two with nonnegative integer exponent. It counts distinct scalar zero levels, not isolated zero points in the product. Noninteger exponents, general domains, and literature not indexed by the performed searches remain outside scope.
title: Negative-real scalar zeros of Euclidean-distance Bergman kernels in every complex-ball dimension
